contents:
[package]
name = "winfsp"
version = "0.13.0+winfsp-2.1"
edition = "2024"
readme = "../README.md"
license = "GPL-3.0"
description = "Rust bindings to WinFSP"
keywords = ["filesystem", "winfsp", "fuse"]
categories = ["filesystem", "os::windows-apis", "api-bindings"]
repository = "https://github.com/SnowflakePowered/winfsp-rs"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
default-target = "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"
targets = []
features = ["full", "docsrs"]

[dependencies]
widestring = "1"
thiserror = "2"
paste = "1"
static_assertions = "1.1"
bytemuck = "1.13"
parking_lot = "0.12.4"

[dependencies.winfsp-sys]
path = "../winfsp-sys"
version = "0.12"

[dependencies.windows]
package = "windows"
version = "0.61.1"
features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_System_LibraryLoader", "Win32_Security", "Win32_Storage_FileSystem", "Win32_System_WindowsProgramming", "Win32_System_Console", "Win32_System_Threading", "Win32_System_ProcessStatus", "Wdk_Foundation"]

[dependencies.windows-56]
package = "windows"
version = "0.56"
features = ["Win32_Foundation"]
optional = true

[dependencies.windows-60]
package = "windows"
version = "0.60"
features = ["Win32_Foundation"]
optional = true

[dependencies.windows-62]
package = "windows"
version = "0.62"
features = ["Win32_Foundation"]
optional = true

[features]
default = ["full", "handle-util"]
debug = []
system = ["windows/Win32_System_Registry", "winfsp-sys/system"]
notify = []
build = []
delayload = ["build"]
docsrs = ["winfsp-sys/docsrs"]
handle-util = []
async-io = []
full = ["notify", "delayload", "async-io"]
windows-61 = []
windows-56 = ["dep:windows-56"]
windows-60 = ["dep:windows-60"]
windows-62 = ["dep:windows-62"]

[package]
name = "winfsp-sys"
version = "0.12.1+winfsp-2.1"
edition = "2021"
license = "GPL-3.0"
description = "Raw bindings to WinFSP"
keywords = ["filesystem", "winfsp", "fuse"]
categories = ["filesystem", "os::windows-apis", "external-ffi-bindings"]
readme = "./README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/SnowflakePowered/winfsp-rs"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
default-target = "x86_64-pc-windows-msvc"
targets = []
features = ["docsrs"]

[build-dependencies]
bindgen = "0.72.0"

[build-dependencies.windows-registry]
version = "0.6.0"
optional = true

[features]
system = ["dep:windows-registry"]
docsrs = []
